Your team projects 68.3 with the armband on Haaland. The transfer to bring in Watkins costs nothing and nets 6.4 points across the horizon, so you're taking it. Wood drops to the bench and Watkins replaces him in the XI.

Your Arsenal dependence is marked: five players from one club in the starting XI. Mykolenko on the bench at 3.1 is your only meaningful cover if that concentration sours. The rest of the bench is thin.

The free transfer spent well here. Get Watkins in and play it through.
